prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in earlier and adding targeted sign-in hints or copy improved conversion, whereas placing sign-in after the adoption certificate severely hurt conversion.
Adding focused individual screens (Interactive Welcome, Sound Calibration, Pet Personality Intro, Visibility Check) won, while multi-step setup flows consistently degraded conversion.
Select layout redesigns (Pick Friend stage/carousel, Story scroll/stage/carousel, Choose Path grid, Checklist intro) won, but photo upload redesigns and waiting screen spotlight redesigns severely hurt conversion.
Desktop activity and interaction hints won, whereas standalone headline updates, audio cues, progress bars, and tip carousels mostly showed no clear effect.
Predictions were overly pessimistic for major winning features, forecasting negative or small gains (such as -0.2% or -7.8%) for changes that delivered up to +14.0% improvements.
Predictions were overly optimistic for non-winning or failing changes, forecasting gains up to +12.0% on interventions that showed no clear effect or caused severe drops.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Account Reconnect Safety Hint: Display a hint on sign-in clarifying that logging into an existing account safely recovers previously created pets and settings. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets when users accidentally log in under a new account.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Reorder Sign-In After Pick Friend Screen: Move the sign-in step to immediately after selecting a companion on the pick_friend screen. (why: Placing sign-in right after pet selection captures user commitment while keeping account preservation early in the funnel.)
2: [adoption, new_screen] New Companion Name Confirmation Screen: Add a dedicated pet naming screen right after pick_friend where users enter and confirm their pet's name. (why: Adoption step has high drop-off (86.4%) and long duration (89s); giving users a quick dedicated naming moment increases personal connection.)
3: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Screen Two Column Layout Redesign: Redesign the Pick Friend companion selection screen to use a side-by-side two-column layout. (why: Adoption step takes a median of 89s and mean of 1017s, indicating users need a clearer side-by-side view to compare pets faster.)
4: [adoption, hint] Adoption Certificate Companion Guarantee Hint: Add a reassurance hint to the adoption certificate screen confirming desktop pet settings are saved. (why: Adoption step completion drops to 86.4%; reinforcing companion setup completion reduces drop-offs.)
5: [adoption, new_flow] New Companion Mood Preview Screen: Add a short companion mood selection screen after adoption certificate to preview how the pet reacts on desktop. (why: Pre-building post-adoption companion familiarity addresses user confusion about how pets behave and interact.)
6: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen System Tray Loading Hint: Display a background hint on the waiting screen explaining that the pet launches into the system tray when ready. (why: Support reported users lost track of pets on startup or thought the app failed to open after generation.)
7: [finish, notification] Home Intro Companion Tray Icon Prompt: Enable background system notification on the home intro screen directing users to the taskbar tray icon. (why: Multiple support emails showed confusion regarding how to find, show, or control the pet on the desktop after setup.)
8: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Screen Centered Layout Redesign: Redesign the home intro screen layout to a centered focus presentation with primary action buttons. (why: Finish step drops to 80.0% conversion; a clean centered layout reduces visual clutter on final setup.)

scores.note: Sign-in hints have strong historical backing (+2.1% avg) and direct support email evidence.
Moving sign-in earlier fits general lessons, but sign-in reordering tests averaged -4.5% historically.
Adoption has high drop-off (13.6%); focused individual screens have strong history (+6.3% avg).
Long adoption time supports intervention, but adoption redesigns consistently hurt conversion (-5.6% avg).
Low-cost reassurance hint at high drop-off step, though general copy/hints have modest impact.
Multi-step setup flows consistently degrade conversion despite intent to set post-adoption expectations.
Directly backed by support tickets and desktop interaction hint lessons, with positive historical data.
Finish step has highest drop (20%) and multiple emails, but notifications on finish average -0.3%.
Finish step offers huge recovery potential; finish redesigns show modest positive historical gains (+1.4%).
